visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a striped polo shirt and denim skirt, stands outdoors in a bright, sunny environment. She holds a light grey smartphone in her right hand, positioned as if taking a selfie. On the phone screen, her own reflection is visible, clearly showing a bright red pimple on her left cheek while she smiles broadly. (2) The woman shifts the phone to display a pre-captured image of a young man who also has a prominent pimple on his cheek. She uses her left index finger to point enthusiastically at the screen and then points to her own face, her expression filled with excitement and a sense of shared connection. (3) A sudden close-up reveals the woman's face as she gently touches the red blemish on her cheek with her finger. Large, bold Chinese characters '情侶痘' (Couple Pimple) appear as a center-screen overlay. The background shows blurred green foliage and architectural elements of a park or campus. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor living room at night. The woman sits on a couch, illuminated by the cool blue glow of her smartphone and a dim ambient light. She continues to inspect her skin while wearing a light-colored t-shirt, appearing focused on maintaining the condition of the pimple on her face. (5) In a bright indoor setting, the woman is seen eating McDonald's French fries from a red carton while sitting in front of a laptop. She looks energetic and happy, munching on the oily food with a deliberate intent to keep the 'couple pimple' active. (6) Back outdoors on a sunny day, the woman walks through a paved plaza and spots a young man walking ahead of her. He is wearing a blue plaid shirt and a black 'Supreme' backpack. She approaches him with a joyful smile and taps him on the shoulder to get his attention. (7) As the man turns around, the woman's face freezes in shock. The close-up shows her wide eyes and open mouth as she realizes the man's skin is now completely clear and blemish-free. She immediately turns and runs away from him. (8) The video cuts to a product shot of a tube of Avene Cleanance cream lying on a wooden texture. Subsequent clips show the woman applying the cream to her face in both indoor and outdoor settings. Yellow and white text overlays provide technical details about the product. (9) In the final sequence, the woman's skin is clear and glowing. She approaches the man again in an open urban square. She bows deeply and holds out the tube of cream in a gesture of confession. The man, however, gives a slight wave and walks away, leaving her standing alone.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我跟學長長了一顆一模一樣的痘痘. (2) [Variety]: 情侶痘. (3) [Subtitle]: 為了這顆情侶痘, 我每天都拼命熬夜, 狂吃油炸食物. (4) [Subtitle]: 現在我們終於有真正的夫妻臉了. 學長如果看到一定會很開心. (5) [Subtitle]: 哈, 他的痘痘不見了. 這樣就不是夫妻臉了耶. (6) [Subtitle]: 沒關係我有雅漾A醛速效淨痘精華. (7) [Slogan]: 獨特黃金3重淨痘成分. 甘草酸 6%. A醛 0.1%. 淨痘複合精華 7%. (8) [Slogan]: 1天淨痘有感. 15天痘痘體積-92%. (9) [Subtitle]: 學長! 我喜歡你. 不用, 謝謝.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Narration starts with high energy and a fast pace. The BGM is an upbeat pop track with a bright synth melody and a steady 4/4 drum machine beat. The woman's voice has a high pitch and positive valence. (2) A distinct 'click' SFX plays as she touches her phone screen. The BGM and narration continue seamlessly, maintaining a humorous and lighthearted atmosphere as she points to her pimple. (3) A 'ding' bell SFX rings when the man's photo appears. The narrator's pitch variability increases as she expresses excitement. The acoustic background is clean studio-style narration mixed with pop music. (4) A 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs as the scene changes to night. The BGM lowers slightly in volume to allow the woman's determined, lower-pitched narration to remain clear as she describes her nighttime tactics. (5) A 'rustle' SFX is heard as she grabs fries from a bag. Her speech rate remains high, and the BGM maintains its tempo while her voice exhibits high arousal. (6) A 'record scratch' comedic stop SFX occurs when she encounters the man with clear skin. The BGM stops abruptly, creating a strategic silence that emphasizes her high-pitched, shocked vocal reaction. (7) A 'pop' SFX marks the introduction of the product tube. A new, more energetic version of the BGM starts. The narration becomes more enunciated and informative, listing ingredients with crisp articulation. (8) A final 'tap' SFX is heard as she touches the man's backpack. His voice is heard for the first time: a calm, low-arousal male voice. The BGM fades out with a simple melodic resolution as he walks away.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous storytelling approach about a woman wanting a 'couple pimple' with her crush to advertise Avene Cleanance skincare. It cleverly pivots from comedic obsession with a blemish to showing the product's efficacy in removing it once the crush's skin becomes clear.
